statement: For every real v in [0,1) and every integer n >= 1, with h_v and K_v interpreted exactly as in source.md and problem.md, K_v(n+v) = n^2 + K_v(1+v) - 1.
contribution: A complete breakpoint-free proof of the frozen universal identity. It proves a reusable quantile lemma for every integer-valued base distribution of oscillation at most three, verifies that every h_v meets that hypothesis, and computes its exact mean. This independently supplies the universal closure omitted from the cited source's finite-verification description; no priority claim is made.
